source_rule: Do not edit E1 shared files while its role is active. H may build an isolated snapshot after contract/source freeze and record all integration deltas. Do not repeat an unchanged target build already supplied formally.
board_artifacts_needed: Exact OLED target app/build/SHA/manifest and app-only partition/flash compatibility
Source snapshot and public contract hashes, native target compile evidence
Runtime identity/baud, saved autonomous mode/boot autostart, stop/drain and explicit exit semantics
Original per-board return apps and known good factory backup references
runtime_contract_needed: Local volatile link_filter allow-list/clear, default unrestricted behavior
Application admission identity even when waiting for route; no immediate concrete next hop implied
Unambiguous packet_kind for DATA versus RREQ/RREP/ERROR identities and TX events
Actual route request/reply candidates/selected path, invalidation and local delivery_unknown/no_route events
Actual per-hop DATA forwarding/receive and final rx_local original bytes
routes and neighbors read-only status, route/core queue drain state and resource/timing counters
acceptance_rule: Only use observed board selection; never install A-B-C or A-D-C as an answer. Preserve any lost/unknown packet and verify recovery with a different newly accepted business identity.
handoff_channel: Local task card and saved artifacts; no attempt to bypass the prior cross-thread notification auto-review rejection.
